nonBlockingIssues.description: _run_coroutine_sync return type annotation is imprecise; mypy would flag it. Uses Callable[[], Awaitable[PipelineResult]] -> PipelineResult but also handles StageResult.
StageType.DYNAMIC_ANALYSIS exists in the enum but is not handled in _dispatch_stage_execution (pre-existing gap, not a regression).
thread.join() in _run_coroutine_sync threading fallback has no timeout. If coroutine hangs, calling thread blocks forever.
Concurrency timing test assertion (elapsed < expected - 0.1) may be flaky on heavily loaded CI machines.
memory_forensics_dispatch_history in GPUAccelerator grows unboundedly. Could accumulate significant memory in long-running sessions.
Pre-existing: hashlib.sha512() in _extract_artifact_from_region computes a hash that is never stored.
_get_accelerator() silently creates a default GPUAccelerator when none is injected, swallowing PyTorch import errors at debug level.
